subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should ordinary `message.send` strip or avoid all poll creation fields, or should OpenClaw keep rejecting content-bearing poll fields such as `pollQuestion` and `pollOption` on send?
rationale: Current main intentionally fixed metadata-only false positives but still rejects content-bearing poll fields, and relaxing that behavior affects the model-facing shared message-tool contract across channels.

options.title: Action-scope poll schema
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` or poll-capable scoped surfaces so ordinary sends cannot inherit them from the shared schema.

options.title: Sanitize on send
options.body: Keep the unified schema but strip poll creation fields from `action="send"` before the guard and channel dispatch.

options.title: Keep current guard
options.body: Accept the partial fix and require fresh live evidence before relaxing content-bearing poll-field rejection on send.

recommendation.title: Action-scope poll schema
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` or poll-capable scoped surfaces so ordinary sends cannot inherit them from the shared schema.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses outbound runtime, tool schema, and channel contract boundaries where steipete has the broadest recent adjacent history.
